reviewPolicy: All suggestions below are in 'PROPOSED — AWAITING REVIEW' status. Review the Strategic Paths and individual suggestions, resolve prerequisite Questions (Q-E01..Q-E07), and approve a path BEFORE implementing production changes.

strategicPaths.name: Market & Validation Infrastructure First (Recommended)
strategicPaths.sequence: SUG-03 (Odds & CLV Ledger) -> SUG-12 (Pre-Kickoff Hash Log) -> SUG-04 (Play-by-Play EPA & Prop Copula Engine)
strategicPaths.primaryBenefit: Unlocks Validation Gates G3, G4, and G6 immediately so strategies can be ranked by true Out-of-Sample CLV rather than staying quarantined in Tier 0.

strategicPaths.name: 32-Club Injury & Backup String Advantage First
strategicPaths.sequence: SUG-02 (32-Club Depth-Chart Crawler) -> SUG-09 (PS 3-Elevation Cap Tracker) -> SUG-01 (Friday/90-Min Inactive Diff Banner)
strategicPaths.primaryBenefit: Captures early-week line movement caused by 2nd/3rd/4th-string OL and CB cascades (where 2026 Def Passer Rtg vs PA/G r=+0.8151 and Sack Rate vs PF/G r=-0.6353).

strategicPaths.name: Pricing Precision & Situational Edge First
strategicPaths.sequence: SUG-06 (Discrete Key-Number 3/7 Pricing) -> SUG-07 (NOAA/NWS Stadium Wind Overlay) -> SUG-08 (SGP Vig-Tax Auditor)
strategicPaths.primaryBenefit: Eliminates Gaussian push mispricing around key numbers 3 & 7, prices outdoor wind totals, and blocks negative-EV SGP parlay markups.

strategicPaths.name: UI Decision-Safety & Repo Hygiene First
strategicPaths.sequence: SUG-05 (Go/No-Go Pre-Bet Checklist Drawer) -> SUG-10 (Calibration Reliability Curves) -> SUG-11 (Cross-Session CR-01/CR-02 Cleanup)
strategicPaths.primaryBenefit: Hardens operator decision workflow against stale data, cognitive bias, and HTML/URL inconsistencies with zero external API cost.

suggestions.title: Automated Data-Staleness Banner & Wed/Thu/Fri Injury Diff View
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Highlights player practice upgrades/downgrades (e.g., DNP -> Limited or Questionable -> Out) and blocks line use if snapshot >24h old.

suggestions.title: All-32 Official Club Depth-Chart Archiver (1st–4th String Offense & Defense)
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Expands our verified 4-club depth-chart proof-of-concept (NE, DET, GB, WAS) to all 32 official club domains with weekly diffs.

suggestions.title: Timestamped Multi-Book Open/Close Odds Ledger & Shin Vig Stripper
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Computes exact vig-free market probabilities and Closing Line Value (CLV) so strategies can pass Gate G4 scientifically.

suggestions.title: Multi-Season Play-by-Play EPA & On/Off Replacement-Value Engine
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Replaces blank injury point-deltas and blank SGP game-level correlations with empirical snap-weighted estimates.

suggestions.title: Interactive Pre-Decision Go/No-Go Gate Checklist on Every Matchup Row
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Requires checking 6 mandatory boxes (Freshness, 90-min Inactives, Neutral/Weather, Key #3/#7, Gate Pass, Kelly Cap) before marking a play actionable.

suggestions.title: Discrete NFL Key-Number Margin Distribution (3, 7, 6, 10, 4, 14)
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Prices buying/selling half-points across -2.5/-3/-3.5 and -6.5/-7/-7.5 using empirical NFL scoring quanta instead of smooth Normal CDF.

suggestions.title: NOAA / National Weather Service Stadium Wind & Roof-Status Feed
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Automatically flags outdoor games with >=15 mph sustained wind or precipitation where passing YPA and FG % drop sharply.

suggestions.title: Same-Game Parlay (SGP) Hidden Vig-Tax & Copula Fair-Odds Inspector
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Compares sportsbook SGP payout against bivariate copula joint probability so users reject heavily taxed correlated parlays.

suggestions.title: Practice-Squad 3-Elevation Cap & <8-OL Penalty Alert Tracker
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Tracks official NFL Operations 3-elevation player limits and 8-OL gameday active minimums to spot forced 4th-string street signings early.

suggestions.title: Out-of-Sample Reliability Diagram & Rolling CLV Control Chart
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Visualizes model overconfidence and detects strategy decay early via cumulative sum (CUSUM) CLV control limits.

suggestions.title: Apply Logged Cross-Session Patches CR-01 & CR-02 to Legacy Root Pages
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Fixes legacy REG9 link mismatch, Ben Brown C position, lines-lab.html:56 missing <td>, and unsourced legacy rows.

suggestions.title: Cryptographic Pre-Kickoff Strategy Pick Hash Ledger (Gate G1)
suggestions.decisionImprovement: Commits SHA-256 hashes of timestamped strategy picks prior to kickoff so no strategy can retroactively cherry-pick results.
